metric_drive_loss.prompt_directive: Drive validation loss below 0.1 on the demo training tool.
metric_drive_loss.raw_response:
```json
[
  {
    "criterion_id": "val_loss_below_0.1",
    "kind": "metric_threshold",
    "required": true,
    "metric": "metrics.val_loss",
    "op": "<",
    "target": 0.1
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "find_examples_succeeded",
    "kind": "tool_call_succeeded",
    "required": true,
    "tool_name": "find_examples",
    "min_count": 1
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "no_errors",
    "kind": "predicate",
    "required": true,
    "expression": "len(obs.get('errors', [])) == 0"
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "metrics_present",
    "kind": "predicate",
    "required": true,
    "expression": "'val_loss' in obs.get('metrics', {})"
  },
  {
    "criterion_id": "val_loss_monitored",
    "kind": "event",
    "required": false,
    "event_name": "metrics_reported"
  }
]
```
